messages:
elaine: Heads up — procurement rejected a batch of POs across AWS and GCP marketplaces. Portal returns duplicate_batch_id for a vendor payload (batch_id=0x7f12). Blocking a few deals (Sapphire, Northstar). Can we triage now?

mike-eng: Oof. Is that coming from the vendor portal generator or our connector dedupe? Error code?

elaine: Marketplace response: 409 CONFLICT - duplicate_batch_id. The vendor-portal v2 released yesterday appears to have switched to a deterministic batch generator for older partners (removed entropy seed). Two different vendor accounts ended up with same batch id. Connector normalizes to po_batch_id and fails dedupe.

aj: Assigning to eng-platform to investigate. @mike-eng @devon-sre can you take a look at connector dedupe logic? cc @carmen-legal for PO uniqueness implications.

sarah-prod: This touches dedicated/reserved commits for Acmecloud trial — finance flagged SLA risk. Need quick mitigation.

procurement-bot: Procurement alert: 3 POs failed validation (PO-1456, PO-1457, PO-1458). Link: https://vendor-portal.internal/errors/1765554321

deploy-bot: Release note — vendor-portal v2 deployed 2026-03-22T03:14Z (build 2026.03.22-rc1).

mike-eng: Quick check: looks like dedupe uses po_batch_id + vendor_id. But vendor_id was null for these legacy accounts so only batch_id used. Repro locally with batch payload sample.

elaine: Right — vendor_id being null due to legacy account mapping is another bug. Two separate problems: (1) deterministic batch_id collision in vendor portal v2; (2) missing vendor_id normalization on our side.

aj: Short-term workaround idea: accept duplicates during ingestion if vendor provenance differs, by attaching vendor_batch_nonce header (nonce generated in connector for each incoming file) and skip hard 409 when vendor_id mismatch detected. I'll open a quick PR to add header and toggle.

mike-eng: Proposed safe fallback: mark incoming duplicates with header "X-Vendor-Batch-Nonce" + record original payload hash. That avoids dropping POs while preserving idempotency.

carmen-legal: Legal note — we can accept provisional PO numbers if there is signed envelope metadata (signer + timestamp) preserved. Need a one-line contract redline to relax strict PO uniqueness for ingestion replays. I can draft and drop in here by EOD.

marta-finance: Hold on reprocessing until legal signs off on provisional acceptance. Customers with pending credits: Sapphire trial + Northstar proof of concept. Revenue at risk if we reprocess incorrectly.

devon-sre: We can safely requeue the three failed POs once the connector toggles are in place. Recommend scheduling reprocess window at 23:00 PT to minimize impact. Need an idempotency key added to payload (reprocess:true). I can run the job if eng-platform vets the change.

aj: I'll open hotfix PR (branch: hotfix/vendor-batch-nonce) to add X-Vendor-Batch-Nonce and org-level toggle accept_duplicate_batch. Will include a migration to backfill vendor_id where possible. PR link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/connectors/pull/5234 (draft).

elaine: Can procurement provisionally accept the POs with provisional IDs so customers are not blocked? @marta-finance @carmen-legal

carmen-legal: We can accept provisional IDs conditionally if we update the PO uniqueness clause. I'll paste a redline later today. For now, procurement should not finalize cancellation.

marta-finance: OK — hold reprocess until legal posts the redline. Please notify impacted customers that we're working an internal ingest fix and have scheduled a reprocess window pending signoff.

aj: Also pinging partner ops (external) — @marketplace_ops — we need them to fix the vendor portal generator (entropy seam). Elaine, can you send the partner note?

elaine: Will draft email now and include triage summary + ask for immediate generator patch. Draft copy: "Observed duplicate batch_id collisions from vendor-portal v2; request urgent patch to reintroduce entropy or include vendor_id in batch payload. We will deploy a temporary acceptance toggle on our side but need vendor-side fix to prevent recurrence." Thoughts?

sarah-prod: That sounds right. Add affected PO IDs in the note and ask for timeline. :eyes:

marketplace_ops: Thanks for the ping — we see the issue on our side for legacy accounts. Patch to include vendor_uuid in batch envelope is queued. ETA 24 hours. We'll also re-enable entropy for legacy generator as short-term.

devon-sre: Scheduling note: I'll run a dry reprocess tonight at 22:00 PT and a safe requeue at 23:00 PT if legal signs off. I'll capture logs to S3 and tag run with run_id=reprocess-1765554321.

aj: Hotfix checklist: add header, add org toggle, add migration, unit tests, rollback steps (disable toggle + revert). Will request expedited review.

elaine: Summary / action items: (1) @aj open PR (#5234) — hotfix to add X-Vendor-Batch-Nonce + toggle; (2) @carmen-legal draft redline to permit provisional PO acceptance; (3) @marketplace_ops to patch vendor portal to include vendor_uuid + restore entropy; (4) @devon-sre scheduled reprocess 23:00 PT pending legal; (5) @marta-finance hold finalization of cancellations. I'll send partner email and update customers. Will update thread after PR review. :thumbsup:
